posts.title: President Catherine Connolly Releases Statement On PJ Gallagher
posts.description: President Catherine Connolly has released a statement regarding PJ Gallagher's passing . "As President of Ireland may I join with all those who have expressed such deep sadness on learning of the death of PJ Gallagher. PJ was a wonderful comedian, actor and broadcaster who was loved by audiences all across the country, not just for his brilliant humour, but for the honesty and warmth that he brought to all of his work. Over recent years, PJ made a very significant and special contribution in his courageous sharing of the mental health challenges which he faced. This contribution will undoubtedly have helped many others to seek and access the supports which they needed in their own lives. He will be deeply missed. May I express my deepest condolences to PJ's partner Kelly Doolin, to his twin children Milo and Stevie, and to all of his family, friends, colleagues and fans all throughout Ireland and beyond." posts.title: Statement from Radio Nova
posts.description: The entire Bay Broadcasting family, across Radio Nova, is heartbroken. PJ was so much more than a colleague; he was a treasured friend whose humour, warmth, kindness and wonderfully individual outlook on life enriched the lives of those fortunate enough to work alongside him. Together with his great friend and on-air partner Jim McCabe, PJ brought laughter, warmth and an infectious sense of fun into the lives of listeners every morning on Radio Nova’s Morning Glory. Their natural chemistry, genuine friendship and wonderful ability to complement one another made for something truly special. For so many listeners, PJ and Jim were more than voices on the radio; they were friends who shared their mornings, brightened their days and made the everyday a little brighter. Beyond his remarkable talent as a comedian, actor and broadcaster, PJ was a courageous and honest advocate for mental health. His willingness to speak so openly and candidly about his own experiences helped break down barrier
